description: Kollektivtrafik i Malmö stad is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Malmö stad. Public transport routes in Malmö city The data set includes Torup's recreation area¹ and is used by the Property and Street Office as a basis for prioritized road maintenance. The data contains the subsets of the line positions that lie within the outer boundaries of the city of Malmö and the Torup recreation area. Coverage: Malmö stad. The portal shows the English title as "Public transport in Malmö city" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Malmö stad. Its keywords include Skånetrafiken, karta, gis, geodata, väghållning, map. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
